methodology.title: Curated source-first AI intelligence brief
methodology.summary: This dataset is generated from public source feeds. Items are linked back to their original URLs, timestamped, and auto-categorized for triage rather than treated as infallible truth.
caveats: Feed freshness depends on source publication latency and RSS availability.
Threads coverage uses RSSHub adapters and may fail or lag if the upstream route changes.
Automatic categorization is heuristic and should be reviewed for decision-critical workflows.

news.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
news.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

news.title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
news.summary: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

news.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
news.summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

news.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
news.summary: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.

news.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
news.summary: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

news.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
news.summary: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

news.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
news.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

news.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
news.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

news.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
news.summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

news.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
news.summary: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

news.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
news.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

news.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
news.summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.
